english: <primary/>Primary Weapon Kills grant 'Terminal Velocity' for 6 seconds, providing 20 Reload Speed and 5% decreased Reload Animation Duration to <primary/>Primary weapons. Destroying Constructs and other 'destroyable entities' also activates the buff.

source.text:
2 Piece | Terminal Velocity

Upon scoring a Primary Weapon Kill:
+20 Reload Speed and 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier for Primary Weapons for 6 seconds.
Buff can be triggered by destroying "destroyable entities" as well as Constructs.
